description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is an increase in access to quality healthcare services and products as well as further improvement in reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in Georgia. The Project will help supporting Georgia Capital in facilitating the growth of its portfolio companies, particularly in the areas of pharmacy retail, clinics and diagnostics businesses. The Project will also contribute to reducing GHG emissions in Georgia, by further implementing energy efficient measures by Georgia Capital and its portfolio companies. Beyond the project, IFC anticipates that this investment will deepen the financial integration of corporates into capital markets, including the adoption of sustainability practices, through the demonstration effect channel. IFCs investment will support the largest sustainability-linked bond issuance listed in Georgia and the Caucasus, paving the way for future such issuances in the region.

The proposed IFC investment supports the issuance of a 5-year, US$150 million sustainability-linked bond (SLB) on the Georgia Stock Exchange (GSE) by Georgia Capital JSC (GCap), with an own-account subscription of up to US$30 million as an anchor investor (the Project). GCap is an investment holding company focusing on buying, building and developing businesses in Georgia. Its portfolio is diversified across key sectors in Georgia, including banking, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, insurance, utilities, hospitality, education, and renewable energy.
